PSSSB Clerk IT 2027 - Eligibility, Syllabus & Pattern

The last official Clerk IT notification, the 2027 outlook, and a subject-wise plan built on real papers.

I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). Clerk IT is the clerk post where a computer degree actually pays off: the general clerk paper is open to every graduate, but the Clerk IT paper is mostly your own subject. This page puts the official rules in one place.

The latest round is PSSSB Advertisement No. 12 of 2026 (published 18 September 2026, applications 25 September to 19 October 2026). It has 11 Clerk IT posts at Rs 19,900 - 9 in the Labour Commissioner's office, 1 in Excise and Taxation (head office) and 1 in Civil Aviation. The written exam date is still awaited. Before that, Advt 11/2025 had 1 Clerk IT post, examined on 28 February 2026.

Will there be posts in 2027?

Clerk IT has been advertised in 2021, 2022, 2025 and 2026. The numbers swing a lot - from a single post in Advt 11/2025 to 11 in Advt 12/2026 - because each department asks separately, and each sets its own degree list. In Advt 12/2026 the Labour Commissioner accepts B.Tech CS, B.Sc IT, BCA, or a graduate with PGDCA, while Excise and Taxation asks for a graduate in Computer Application, IT, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Computer Technology. Read the department line before you apply. A further round in 2027-28 is a realistic possibility.

Eligibility (Advt 11/2025)

  1. A full-time BCA, B.Sc IT or B.Sc Computer Science from a recognised university or institution.
  2. A typing test in Punjabi and English at 30 words per minute, held by the recruiting authority.
  3. Punjabi at matriculation (10th) level, as per the Punjab Civil Services Rules, 1994.
  4. Your degree certificate must be dated before the last date to apply.

Age, fee and pay

  • Age (as on 1 January 2025): 18 to 37 years; up to 42 for SC and BC of Punjab, 45 for government employees, 47 for persons with disabilities, 40 for widows and divorcees.
  • Fee: General Rs 1,000; SC/BC/EWS Rs 250; ex-servicemen Rs 200; persons with disabilities Rs 500.
  • Pay: Rs 19,900 (Level-2, 7th CPC).

Selection process

StageWhatRole
Part AMatric-level Punjabi (MCQ)Qualifying - at least 50%
Part BMain paper on the board's syllabusMerit list is made only from Part B
Typing test30 wpm English and Punjabi (Raavi font), on computerQualifying only
CounsellingDocuments and department preferenceAbout three times the posts are called
  • Part B marking: 1 mark per question, 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer.
  • Ties: older candidate first, then higher percentage in the degree, then matric marks.

What the main paper covers

In the 2022 round (Advt 15/2022) the paper had 120 questions in 2 hours: 90 from the Clerk IT subject and 30 from GK, English, Punjabi and reasoning. The subject syllabus is a full BCA-level course:

  • Computer fundamentals - networks, internet, email, office tools
  • Operating systems - process scheduling, deadlocks, memory management, paging, I/O
  • DBMS - ER model, keys, SQL (DDL, DML, DCL), normalisation up to BCNF and 5NF, transactions
  • Computer organisation - Boolean algebra, K-maps, flip-flops, multiplexers, memory
  • Data structures - linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, sorting and searching
  • Programming - C language, flowcharts and algorithms
  • Networks - data communication, OSI and TCP/IP models

Since October 2022 every PSSSB exam also carries the qualifying Punjabi Part A, so plan for both parts.

How to prepare

  1. Solve the real papers. We have Clerk IT papers from 2021, 2022 and 2026 with answer keys - the 2026 paper shows the current level.
  2. DBMS and operating systems decide the rank. They give the most questions and reward exact definitions.
  3. Do C output questions by hand. Pointers, loops and storage classes are standard traps.
  4. Start typing practice early. Raavi Punjabi at 30 wpm takes weeks; many toppers lose the post here.
  5. Don't skip Part A. A 50% floor in Punjabi is easy to clear but fatal to miss.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the qualification for PSSSB Clerk IT?

A full-time BCA, B.Sc IT or B.Sc Computer Science from a recognised university, matric-level Punjabi, and a Punjabi and English typing test at 30 words per minute, as per Advertisement No. 11 of 2025.

What is the salary of PSSSB Clerk IT?

Rs 19,900 at Pay Level-2 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, the same as the general Clerk post.

Is there a typing test for Clerk IT?

Yes. Candidates called after the written exam take a qualifying typing test on computer at 30 wpm in English and in Punjabi (Raavi font). It must be passed, but its marks do not add to merit.

What is the PSSSB Clerk IT exam pattern?

Part A is a qualifying matric-level Punjabi paper where you need 50%. The merit list is made only from Part B, with 1 mark per question and 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer. In the 2022 round the main paper had 90 computer questions and 30 GK, reasoning and language questions.

Will PSSSB release a Clerk IT notification in 2027?

No 2027 notification yet, but PSSSB Advertisement No. 12 of 2026 (applications closed 19 October 2026) has 11 Clerk IT posts. Clerk IT has now appeared in 2021, 2022, 2025 and 2026 advertisements, so further posts are likely whenever departments send demand.
